## Project Code Patterns
- validated-wire-contracts — Wire decoding delegates to domain validation while schemas remain source-aligned.
- injected-core-ports — Domain contracts flow inward; concrete adapters are wired at the composition root.
- registry-declared-surfaces — One registry declaration drives identities, metadata, schemas, and registration.
- bounded-loss-accounting — Bounded streams report every rejected or missed observation as explicit evidence quality state.
- single-writer-effect-reducer — Serialized inputs produce deterministic state and an explicit effect queue.
- exact-release-managed-activation — Plugin/runtime activation derives one exact release version, verifies it before execution, and avoids unconstrained latest-driven updates.
- hermetic-release-boundary-fixtures — Distribution tests shadow external commands and release assets in temp state to verify release seams without network or user-home mutation.
- layered-cdp-qualification — Deterministic doubles, boundary fault injection, and explicit real-browser qualification form one test ladder.
- ordered-sql-migrations — Immutable numbered SQL revisions are centrally ordered and transactionally applied.
- canonical-json-schema-artifacts — Rust models generate canonical checked-in JSON and schemas verified by digest and byte equality.
